Indonesia Eco-Luxury Sumba Island Boutique Beachfront Retreat

Sumba, Indonesia

Absolute serenity, natural elegance, and island eco-luxury are the foundations of Indonesia’s boutique Cap Karoso - perched on the unspoilt western shores of Sumba Island.
